card.name: Dose units and noun heads in formulas
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun phrase or dose unit just before a connecting word or operator, such as mg, /kg, or the end of a drug name in a regimen. Also the head noun in a math or formula phrase.

modes.label: Dose units
modes.description: Units like mg, /kg or the 2 in mg/m2 right after a drug dose number.
modes.example: The recommended dosage in pregnant patients is darunavir 600<< mg>> taken with ritonavir 1

modes.label: Drug name ends in regimens
modes.description: The end of a split brand or generic drug name listed in a combination regimen.

modes.label: Formula noun phrases
modes.description: Head nouns like function, space or piece in math or procedure formulas.
modes.example: the derivative of the whole<< function>> times the derivative of the inner function.

card.plain: It fires at the end of a dose unit or drug name, right before a plus sign, a word like times, or the next item.
